# Curupira Software

> Curupira Software is a Brazilian software company and software house based in Juiz de Fora, Minas Gerais. It develops custom software, SaaS products, web systems, business automation, system integrations and applied AI solutions for companies in Zona da Mata Mineira and across Brazil.

The canonical website is https://curupirasoftware.com/.

## Company
- [About Curupira Software](https://curupirasoftware.com/empresa/): Canonical institutional information.
- [Contact](https://curupirasoftware.com/contato/): Official contact channel.
